offering_description.value: PRA Group buys portfolios of defaulted consumer debt from banks and other lenders. It works with borrowers to resolve balances through payments and settlements, and recovers eligible claims through consumer insolvency proceedings.

primary_services.value: Defaulted debt portfolio purchases; consumer debt recovery; repayment arrangements; insolvency claims administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit card issuers and other consumer lenders selling defaulted accounts; B2C: Individual borrowers resolving balances on accounts PRA Group owns

end_markets.value: Credit card lending; consumer installment lending; retail finance; auto finance; consumer insolvency

revenue_model.value: other: Payments and settlements on purchased accounts, plus distributions on insolvency claims

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Purchases defaulted accounts from lenders and assumes the risk of recovering balances from borrowers; service provider: Administers acquired accounts and arranges repayment or settlements with borrowers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Australia

specialization.value: niche specialist: Purchases and recovers defaulted consumer debt, including accounts in insolvency

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct relationships with lenders and in-house contact centers for borrowers; online: Self-service portals for account management and payments

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Debt collection licensing, U.S. fair debt collection rules and UK Financial Conduct Authority oversight
